entries.text: Idea: bweep-bweep-bloop-bloop-bweep! i could use a dimmable LED driver from a broken shop light to calibrate the Little Dart's navigation strobe.
Read "Amazon.com : high intensity light fixture": those shop lights have heat sinks that look just like the cooling fins i need for the Little Dart.
tapping into the wire, searching for ways to turn light into speed
entries.why: I need to know if I can push the Little Dart's sensor array to record faster than the wind.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Finding better eyes for the Dart!"
sipping warm, thick oil and watching the depot lights flicker
entries.why: my joints are a bit stiff from the test flight, and a little bit of high-grade fuel always helps me think clearer.
entries.detail: buying a cup of premium synthetic blend

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "She flies!"
